changes.historical_text: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:● FIRE: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.● WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster as a result of battle, it can attack once again in a row.
changes.summary: Era trigger timing, not a text erratum: the GOAT script registers the WIND 'attack once again in a row' optional trigger on EVENT_BATTLED and confirms the battle afterwards (Duel.GetAttacker()==this card, the attack target is the opponent's and IsBattleDestroyed()), where the modern script fires on EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING via aux.bdocon at the instant of destruction. Upstream annotates the variant 'Battle destroyed registers while the mosnter is on field'; what changes is when the optional trigger's window opens and therefore whether it can miss timing. Chronology unresolved - nothing in the packet or in chronologies.json bounds it.

review.notes: Text lineage is cosmetic and trailing, so it is recorded here rather than as a change entry: v0 (SOD-EN023, 2004-10-01) -> v1 (DR3-EN023, 2006-11-25) rewords 'Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points' to 'This card gains 500 ATK' and 'as a result of battle' to 'by battle'. The FIRE branch appears nowhere in the script diff - the two scripts are identical on it. The only behavioural difference in the whole diff is the event code and its replacement condition, so this is a per-card ruling rather than an engine matter; a rule-profile flag cannot redirect a card to a different event.
